sources.title: nvfp4 - vLLM
sources.snippet: Configuration for an NVFP4 linear layer. All NVFP4 layers share the same structure: packed uint8 weights (2 FP4 values per byte), FP8-E4M3 per-block weight scales (group size 16), and scalar global scales for both weights and activations. act_dtype is the activation dtype of weight-only layers, when the caller knows it.

sources.title: nvfp4_utils - vLLM
sources.snippet: Pair CSF scale streams back into canonical E4M3 scale tensors. The returned transform is lazy over a (name, tensor) weight stream: tensors named <name>.<stream> for a declared encoding are buffered per scale and, once the encoding's stream set completes, replaced by the decoded <name> tensor; everything else passes through unchanged.
